dialogue.text: Hello, I'm Dr. Agent — I understand your right knee has been getting more painful and swollen. How long has this been going on?
It's been bothering me for about 12 days now. The pain and swelling just keep getting worse, and it's really hard to walk on it.
You mentioned pain when urinating — when did that start, and have you had any discharge from the penis?
The pain when I pee started about 3 weeks ago, maybe a little before the knee thing. And yeah, there's been some discharge too, kind of yellowish.
Have you had any red, irritated eyes, or a rash or sores on your skin, palms, or genitals recently?
Yeah, actually my eyes have been kind of red and irritated for the past week or so. I haven't noticed any rash or sores on my skin though.
Have you had a new sexual partner in the last month or two, and any recent diarrheal illness?
I've been with two different girls in the past couple months, so yeah, there have been new partners. But no, I haven't had any diarrhea or stomach problems recently.

That combination — urethritis, conjunctivitis, and an inflamed joint after a prior self-resolving ankle episode — is very suggestive. Let me confirm with some testing.
